extracted.intended_audience: staff in the Patents Formalities Groups at the UK Intellectual Property Office (IPO)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for IPO formalities examiners on the practice and procedures to be followed when carrying out formalities examination of patent applications under the Patents Act 1977 and the Patents Rules 2007 in the UK. Includes chaptered desk instructions covering forms, inventors, claims, drawings, priority, PCT national phase, divisional applications, time extensions, case management, and related topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and purpose of the Formalities Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: The Formalities Manual explains the Intellectual Property Office's formalities examination practice under the Patents Act 1977. The purpose of this manual is to provide detailed, up-to-date guidelines as to the practice and procedures to be followed in the various aspects of the formalities examination of patent applications in accordance with the Patents Act 1977 and the Patents Rules 2007.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to provide detailed, up-to-date guidance to staff carrying out formalities examinations; material is procedural and practical rather than a substitute for legislation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary intended users / use as desk instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: The guidelines are intended primarily for staff in the Patents Formalities Groups for use as desk instructions in carrying out their daily duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff should use the manual as day-to-day procedural guidance; where situations are not addressed, seek case advice (see next criterion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Escalation / case advice procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Case advice should be sought from the Head of Administration when situations which are not addressed in the manual come to light.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When encountering novel or unaddressed issues, examiners must escalate to the specified authority rather than acting solely on the manual's guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application types covered
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to dealing with normal patent applications filed under s.14 and s.15(9) of the Patent Act 1977 the manual also deals with the practice and procedures to be followed in processing national phase patent applications filed under s.89.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manual guidance applies to standard national filings and to national-phase PCT entries under the cited statutory provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority of the manual versus legislation
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements made in the Manual are not in themselves an authority for any action by the IPO and should not be used as a set of legal requirements. The Patents Act 1977 and the Patents Rules 2007 are the ultimate authority on practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiners and users must treat the Patents Act and Patents Rules as the legal source; the manual is advisory/administrative and cannot override statute or rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating policy and reporting errors
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual will be updated when necessary to reflect changes in legislation or practice. If you notice any errors please email the manual editor: Head of Formalities Training and Technical Processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should report detected errors to the named contact; the manual is maintained and subject to periodic updates to reflect legislative/practice changes.
